narrative: Edge and Node contributed 11 times to Agroverse and TrueSight DAO from September 2023 to February 2025, with contributions primarily in the 100TDG for every 1 hour of human effort category (6 instances total). They brought on passive observers to the DAO (2 instances), provided a booth to showcase their product and service at an event, created a social media blast to advertise media (per channel), and offered use of office/kitchen facilities for an hour under Build Game operations. A notable accomplishment was providing event booth space, supporting DAO visibility.
